baseline.representation: project canonical row-Q4 teacher + FP16 KV

larc.weight_representation: group-64 signed Q4 with FP16 scale per 64-weight sub-row group
larc.conversion: 80-step teacher-layer function prefit, then 200-step hard-projected group-64 QAT recovery at lr=1.5e-3
larc.kv: rank-16 latent Q2; one scalar FP16 min/scale pair per 3-token K group and per 3-token V group; shared Q4 K/V bases; FP16 inverse-Gram for K and V; current residual group retained as FP16 and charged as worst-case FP16 tail

quality_execution_note: Weight quality is evaluated using dequantized values exactly corresponding to stored group-64 Q4 codes. KV quality uses group-3 latent-Q2 simulation with Q4 bases, both ridge-stabilized inverse-Gram corrections, FP16 min/scale metadata, and an FP16 current residual group before group statistics are recomputed. This is representation-faithful quality simulation, not the packed native weight kernel and not measured process memory.
claim_boundary: Controlled synthetic character-LM evidence: >10x modeled tensor-memory versus the project's simple row-Q4 baseline across 64..8192 context, with five-seed mean perplexity ratio 1.047 versus that same baseline. The baseline is not Q4_K_M and the absolute mean ratio versus FP32 teacher is 1.377. This does not establish real pretrained-model quality, measured RAM, or GPU VRAM.
